```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.ticker import StrMethodFormatter
from IPython.display import HTML, display

data_path = Path("data/880-405_laserpower.csv")

if not data_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file was not found: {data_path}")

df = pd.read_csv(data_path)
required = {"power_percentage_values", "03-26_405_power", "03-26_405_error", "08-25_405_power", "08-25_405_error"}
missing = required.difference(df.columns)

if missing:
    raise ValueError(
        "The CSV is missing these columns: "
        + ", ".join(sorted(missing))
    )

if df.empty:
    raise ValueError("The CSV contains no data rows.")

df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="raise")
df["revenue"] = pd.to_numeric(df["revenue"], errors="raise")
df["orders"] = pd.to_numeric(df["orders"], errors="raise")

total_revenue = float(df["revenue"].sum())
total_orders = int(df["orders"].sum())
average_order_value = total_revenue / total_orders if total_orders else 0
latest_date = df["date"].max().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
row_count = len(df)
```

## Revenue over time

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Total revenue by reporting month"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

monthly_revenue = (
    df.assign(month=df["date"].dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp())
    .groupby("month", as_index=False)
    .agg(revenue=("revenue", "sum"))
    .sort_values("month")
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(monthly_revenue["month"], monthly_revenue["revenue"], marker="o")
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(StrMethodFormatter("${x:,.0f}"))
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
fig.autofmt_xdate()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Revenue by region

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Revenue contribution by region"
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

regional_summary = (
    df.groupby("region", as_index=False)
    .agg(revenue=("revenue", "sum"), orders=("orders", "sum"))
    .sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.bar(regional_summary["region"], regional_summary["revenue"])
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(StrMethodFormatter("${x:,.0f}"))
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Regional summary

```{python}
#| echo: false

regional_table = regional_summary.rename(
    columns={"region": "Region", "revenue": "Revenue", "orders": "Orders"}
)

display(
    HTML(
        regional_table.to_html(
            index=False,
            border=0,
            classes="dataframe",
            formatters={
                "Revenue": lambda value: f"${value:,.0f}",
                "Orders": lambda value: f"{value:,.0f}",
            },
        )
    )
)
```

## Product performance

```{python}
#| echo: false

product_summary = (
    df.groupby("product", as_index=False)
    .agg(revenue=("revenue", "sum"), orders=("orders", "sum"))
    .sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
    .rename(
        columns={"product": "Product", "revenue": "Revenue", "orders": "Orders"}
    )
)

display(
    HTML(
        product_summary.to_html(
            index=False,
            border=0,
            classes="dataframe",
            formatters={
                "Revenue": lambda value: f"${value:,.0f}",
                "Orders": lambda value: f"{value:,.0f}",
            },
        )
    )
)
```
